Chapter 1105: 27 Chaos Secret Patterns (Seeking Subscription)_2

Chapter 1105: Chapter 27 Chaos Secret Patterns (Seeking Subscription)_2

After all the powers are fused together and amplified by the war machine, the final explosive strike will increase by hundreds of times.

This is the war machine.

“These secret patterns…”

Lin Yuan observed carefully.

[Your insight is unparalleled, observing unknown patterns, enhancing your understanding of the Chaos Rule…]

…

Numerous flashes of inspiration erupted in his mind, ultimately enhancing Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Chaos Rule.

“These secret patterns, can they actually directly enhance the understanding of the Chaos Rule?”

Lin Yuan found it hard to believe.

All along, Lin Yuan’s method of enhancing his understanding of the Chaos Rule was by continually comprehending other rules and pathways.

These pathways would drive the enhancement of his understanding of the Chaos Rule.

But now?

Comprehending the secret patterns on the war machine can yield a similar effect?

“The essence of secret patterns is the fundamental vein of the Chaos Rule.”

“In any world or realm, there is no definite Chaos Rule because at the moment of the world’s creation, the Chaos Rule had already differentiated into innumerable pathways of rules.”

“Want to directly comprehend the Chaos Rule? There’s simply no such opportunity.”

While comprehending the secret patterns on the war machine, Lin Yuan thought to himself.

“And these war machines have actually condensed the fundamental vein of the Chaos Rule? Who on earth managed to do that?”

Lin Yuan marveled inwardly.

Currently, his understanding of the Chaos Rule had also reached the Second Realm.

But let alone condensing the Second Realm’s vein of the Chaos Rule, even the First Realm is impossible to achieve.

Sometimes comprehending and expressing it are two different things.

“No wonder the war machine can perfectly fuse the powers of countless Dominator Realm experts, no wonder, no wonder…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts surged.

When he first discovered the effects of the war machine, he found it utterly unbelievable.

The higher one’s realm, the broader one’s vision, and the more unbelievable these methods of fusing numerous power rules become.

But upon seeing the war machine himself.

Lin Yuan immediately accepted it. Only the Origin Rule, like the Chaos Rule, which can derive countless pathways of rules, can achieve the convergence of vastly different power rules.

Innumerable pathways of rules originate from chaos and will return to chaos.

“In my understanding of the Chaos Rule, I have only just entered the Second Realm. To use chaos as the foundation to evolve the Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji Power, it requires at least the pinnacle of the Second Realm, or possibly the Third Realm.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The difficulty of evolving the Chaos Yin-Yang Taiji Power exceeded Lin Yuan’s expectations; he originally thought the Second Realm of the Chaos Rule was sufficient.

“Not to mention the Third Realm of Chaos, even the pinnacle of the Second Realm of Chaos, at my current pace of understanding, how long would it take? A million years? Ten million years?”

Lin Yuan pondered.

Enhancing the understanding of the Chaos Rule is not about enhancing a singular rule but rather the enhancement of the understanding of all rules.

This requires an enormous expenditure of time and energy.

“Too long.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

If the Chaos Great Saints knew Lin Yuan’s thoughts, they might be so ashamed they’d choose to reincarnate immediately.

A million or ten million years to raise the Chaos Rule from the Second Realm to the pinnacle of the Second Realm? Many Chaos Great Saints have not achieved this in a thousand or ten thousand Cosmic Eras.

A large portion of Chaos Great Saints still remain at the initial stage of the Second Realm in understanding the Chaos Rule.

“But these war machines…”

Lin Yuan stared at the war machine in front of him with radiant expression.

Through the secret patterns on the surface of the war machine, Lin Yuan could directly enhance his understanding of the Chaos Rule, a process that is tens of thousands of times simpler than conventional methods.

And as his understanding of the Chaos Rule improved, it would naturally enhance his understanding of the other countless pathways of rules.

“Luckily I didn’t leave…”

Lin Yuan felt quite pleased within.

In fact, before the war began, Lord Qingfen had suggested Lin Yuan temporarily leave Qingfen Domain.

In Lord Qingfen’s eyes, Lin Yuan was a core royal bloodline with immense potential, and as soon as he stepped into the Great Lord realm, he would be able to easily sweep across many Great Lords.

Before that, it was naturally better to keep a low profile and not involve himself in the war between the two great domains.

But after considering it, Lin Yuan still refused Lord Qingfen’s suggestion.

Firstly, because Lord Qingfen had been good to him, Lin Yuan was reluctant to leave at such a critical moment.

Secondly, Lin Yuan knew his own capabilities well; with his strength, unless the ancestors of the major ancient countries intervened, it would be difficult for him to die.

Whether to leave Qingfen Domain or not… truthfully speaking, it didn’t make much of a difference to Lin Yuan.

Now it seems.

Lin Yuan’s decision was very correct.

If he had left Qingfen Domain, he certainly wouldn’t have had the chance to come into contact with these war machines.

Each war machine, even a Grade C war machine, is a top secret of the major ancient countries.

Unless a war is waged, they will never appear outside.

Even if a war is waged, outsiders may not have the opportunity to even approach a war machine.

Now Lin Yuan was the commander of this defense area, so he could observe the war machine up close under the pretense of inspection.

…

“Well… you may step back for now.”

Lin Yuan glanced indifferently at Luo Peng standing beside him and said, “I need to stay here for a while.”

“Yes.”

The unicorn man Luo Peng immediately stood and left.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan’s figure flickered and entered the interior of the war machine, where the chaos secret patterns were increasingly complex and profound.

At the same time, they provided increasing help to Lin Yuan.

…

Purple Dream Domain.

One war machine after another operated, with many Great Lords heading to different frontline areas.

Among them, the most powerful Great Lords headed to the core frontline areas, as the core battlefield had the greatest impact, and taking it would have a decisive effect on the war situation.

High sky.

In the depths of multiple layers of space-time.

The Spirit Might King, clad in deep cyan armor, inadvertently emitted an aura that caused the surrounding space-time to distort and collapse.

“The Red Pine King of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country has no ambition and won’t recklessly block me.” The Spirit Might King calmly observed the battlefield.

He dared to choose Qingfen Domain for war, not just because he had arrangements in dozens of nearby domains, but also because he predicted it would likely be the Red Pine King responsible for resisting him.

The Red Pine King was inherently carefree; this was evident from his willingness to leave the capital and live leisurely in his fiefdom.

The capital of an ancient country is its core area; any royalty with a bit of ambition would never willingly leave it.

“The Red Pine King will most likely ask his sixth brother to take action…”

The Spirit Might King thought, considering many possibilities.

“It’s a pity. If not for that Galaxy, the plan would be much simpler in capturing Qingfen City…”

The Spirit Might King sighed; despite his meticulous planning, he never anticipated that Lord Qingfen had secretly nurtured a Great Lord disciple.

A Great Lord disciple, willing to stay hidden in Qingfen City?

If he wasn’t certain his plan wouldn’t be exposed, the Spirit Might King would even suspect a traitor on his side informing Lord Qingfen?

“It’s just as well; only through war, by righteously taking Qingfen Domain and the surrounding dozens of domains, will my prestige reach its peak.”

The Spirit Might King’s gaze was icy.

While war is only about winning or losing, crushing with sheer strength resonates well with those old relics in the capital.

This also significantly benefits his candidacy for emperor.

Of course, to become the emperor of an ancient country, being a candidate is just the start. But not becoming a candidate means having no qualification to compete for the throne.

…

Ding Seven Defense Line.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged inside the war machine, his vast perception enveloping every chaos secret pattern present.

[Your insight is unparalleled, observing unknown patterns, enhancing your understanding of the Chaos Rule…]

…

Unaware of how much time passed, the bursts of inspiration in Lin Yuan’s mind gradually decreased.

“I’ve almost understood them.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes; the chaos secret patterns engraved on a single war machine are ultimately limited.

Merely a Grade C war machine, it couldn’t have engraved too many chaos secret patterns; otherwise, it wouldn’t be Grade C, but Grade B or even Grade A.

“Next one.”

Lin Yuan stepped out and headed towards the next war machine.
